challenges.title: 🧙 Beyond the Five Charts
challenges.description: plot_data() is the whole module — one spell that conjures histograms, bar charts, pies, lines, and scatters depending on what data you feed it. That's a solid foundation, but a lone spell doesn't make a spellbook. This quest is open-ended: expand the module however calls to you — new chart types, new options on plot_data() (saving to a file, custom titles/colors), sharper tests around its type-inference logic, or a deeper tutorial page showing off what it can already do. Any of it moves the needle; all of it makes this guild's chapter feel less like a single page.

challenges.title: 🔮 The Oracle Awakens
challenges.description: easy_ai already speaks in many tongues — it summarizes, translates, rewrites, and reads the mood of a message. But an oracle who only answers when asked isn't much of an oracle. This quest is open-ended: give it a new power (keyword extraction, text classification, question generation — anything that fits the 'wrap an AI call in a friendly function' pattern), sharpen detect_language()'s heuristics (more languages, smarter scoring beyond simple keyword counts), or shore up test coverage around the trickier edge cases.
